entry.name: Settings
entry.label: JSON: {"default": entry, "desktops": {"desktop id": entry}}, entry = {"mode": "image" or "folder", "url", "order": "sequential" or "random", "interval": seconds}.

entry.name: FillMode
entry.label: How the image is fitted to the screen (QtQuick Image.fillMode).

entry.name: Color
entry.label: Colour shown around images that do not cover the screen.

entry.name: CurrentImages
entry.label: Written by the wallpaper: the image currently shown for each virtual desktop, as "desktop id=url". Read by the pager.

entry.name: State
entry.label: Written by the wallpaper: JSON with the image each folder is on and for which interval, so that a pick lasts until its interval is over.
